description: An iteration variable may be named for and used in the element expression
notes: The spec says that where an identifier works as a keyword, its keyword role supersedes any other interpretation, and a for expression is a place where for, in and if work as keywords, so an iteration variable named for could be invalid. hashicorp/hcl accepts it: finishParsingForExpr in hclsyntax/parser.go only checks for TokenIdent where it expects a variable name. The element expression is parsed by parseExpressionTerm, which reads for as a variable.
